definitions.gloss: close contact, sticking closely, adhering tightly
definitions.explanation: Physically sticking closely together with no gap between surfaces.
Following someone or something very closely to observe or report on them. Commonly used in media to describe documentary-style coverage.

notes:
{密着|みっちゃく} combines ⟦{密|みつ}→密：03777_mitsu⟧ (close, tight) and ⟦{着|ちゃく}→着：27655_chaku⟧ (attach, stick).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {密着|みっちゃく}⟦{取材|しゅざい}→取材：05227_shuzai⟧ (close-up interview/coverage)
- {密着|みっちゃく}⟦{番組|ばんぐみ}→番組：01705_bangumi⟧ (behind-the-scenes documentary program)
- ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧{密着|みっちゃく} (community-based, closely tied to the local area)
- ⟦{肌|はだ}→肌：02243_hada⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{密着|みっちゃく}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to adhere to the skin)

USAGE:
Sense 2 is very common in TV and media contexts, where {密着|みっちゃく} describes documentary-style programming that closely follows a subject. ⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧{密着|みっちゃく} is a common phrase meaning "community-oriented" or "locally rooted."
